reviews.text:
Perfect except for the notification badge. I was looking for an app to track custom goals, and this one works very well! You can add custom goals with a picture. There are preset units like dollars or lbs, but you can add custom units like milligrams for reducing your caffeine intake. You can set milestones for your goals. One example would be saving up for a $1,000 emergency fund. You can set milestone goals of $250, $500, and $750 to keep track. One flaw of this program is there’s no built-in way to subtract from a goal or go backwards. So if you have an emergency doctor visit and need to take $100 out of your emergency fund progress, you can’t. You have to undo a previous goal and redo it at a lower amount which means your recorded history is inaccurate.

You can set up daily activities with reminders. I write in a journal every day, so I have a daily reminder for it. You have the option to link it to a goal. The problem with these activities is the red notification badge app icon. It appears whenever you have an upcoming activity for the day. I write at the end of the day which means there is an annoying 🔴 on my screen all day, calling my attention for no reason. There should be an option to change it so that the icon only appears when something is past due so that it actually means something. 

Speaking of options, there are a lot of good options in this app, including a dark mode.
